correctness.rationale: The eighteen integer identities B_j^T P_lambda+P_lambda^T B_j=0 give three generically independent common left annihilators of six columns. Density of that nonempty Zariski-open set forces all 28 six-by-six minors to be identically zero, independently confirmed by exact coefficient expansion. The integer window (31,47,61,73,89,107,127,149) has rank five for each of the 595665 phase-space-normalized five-column subsets modulo the verified prime 1000003, using the packaged deterministic exhaustive checker. Time-frequency translation invariance covers every five-column subset; nonzero modular minors certify complex independence. Finite intersection of nonzero-minor open sets proves genericity. Unique two-term and colliding three-term expansions follow algebraically. The only finite computation is explicitly bounded and complete.

value.rationale: The spark is the natural minimal collision size for sparse time-frequency synthesis. The exact value six for the canonical eight-point elementary abelian group produces a sharp two-atom uniqueness/three-atom ambiguity boundary, not implied by the known no-full-spark dichotomy. The universal circuit is structural, via three sparse alternating annihilators, and the lower certificate checks a complete natural family of minors rather than an arbitrary parameter slice.
